title: Payment API returning timeout errors
description: Multiple customers are unable to complete payments. The payment service is returning intermittent timeout errors. The issue started shortly after the latest deployment.

title: Users intermittently unable to log in
description: Several users are reporting intermittent authentication failures. Login requests sometimes return an authentication service error.

title: Document processing requests are delayed
description: Document processing requests are taking several minutes to complete. The queue has grown significantly since this morning.
